Today's story takes place 7 years ago.

Back then my life was very different to how it is today. I was a 17 year old hamplanetarium, living in a tiny apartment with one of my friends, with more ambition than money, and enough beer and cheap weed to make a frat party look like a church reading group. I was a tattoo apprentice, leaping at every opportunity to learn new techniques, and make people happy with the work I did. I was young. Enthusiastic. The weight of adulthood hadn't yet stomped all over my hopes and dreams.

But on that day, someone sure as shit attempted to.

My boss at the time was the guy that gave me my first tattoo. I'm still close with him to this day and he gave me a shot at it and I worked my ass off every waking hour to produce a shit ton of sketches and did as many tattoos as possible to earn his respect, and returning clients. So there I am, happily sketching away when the door to the shop flys open, almost smashing the glass as it does. I look up startled, the nib of my pencil breaking as I do, only to see a circular mass standing in the doorway, its features blacked out from the light behind it. Bit strange for a lunar eclipse, I thought.

And then it took a step forward under the spotlight. It stood before me, a colossal mound of gelatinous flesh, with a face and no neck settled on top of its vast girth. It was somehow wearing my grandmother's curtains fixed loosely around itself, I assume so it resembled a dress of some kind, albeit one designed by a blind toddler. It started waddling towards me, wheezing with each breath, and I instinctively leaned back, my pencil dropping on the floor. As I bent down to pick it up and sit uprightFUCK IT'S RIGHT IN FRONT OF ME.

It was a monster.

It stood grinning at me inanely, its udders thrust out at me like sagging torpedoes, a small, greasy piece of paper shuffling between its filthy hands.

"Hi! I want a tattoo please"

"Ohh-- oh shit."

My boss was standing behind me laughing and put his hand on my shoulder, grabbing his coat and walking towards the door.

"Wh- where are you going??" I cried frantically.

"Lunch", he said, winking at me on the way out and laughing to himself. "Mind the shop."

"So what I want is a little bit... private teehee"

My eyes widened. I knew what that meant. Its cavernous mouth was opening and closing as I stared ahead of me, blanking out. My whole life flashed before my eyes. My first kiss. My first fuck. Basically what normally flashed before my eyes as a hormonal teenager at least 8 times a day. But my stomach sank and twisted in knots.

"- and I want it here."

"You're pointing at your crotch."

"Well, it's just above there I want it heehee!"

Please save me Jesus. I'll believe in you if you save me now.

"Okay, so what do you want."

It leaned forward, its shit smelling extensions brushing my table and I finally got a close up look of its face. It looked like goddamn coagulated cheese.

"Lucky. You."

"Sorry??"

She stood up proudly, holding her head back with undeserved pride as if she'd just cracked cold fusion. My eyes started welling up with tears of laughter before realising again that I was the only one in the shop.

"I want 'Lucky You' just above my waistline."

For fuck sake.

I looked around foolishly, like a kid who lost its mother in the supermarket. Nobody there to help me. I love this job. I don't want to lose it.

"Ok fine."

I print out a tiny lettered version of the bullshit she wanted out onto the stencil, and ask her to sign a waiver and go lay down. She steps into my room, almost knocking over my toolbox with all my needles and inks in them. She removed granny's curtains to expose a mountainous sack of flesh with 25 years of food abuse stored inside it. Looking at it practically killed the prospect of getting a hard on for the next 50 years.

I put the stencil a half inch above the waistline of her underwear, which is obviously filthy, and let it dry and tell her I'm going for a smoke while it dries. I stepped into the bathroom and looked at myself in the mirror.

Well this is it, hamplanetarium. You always wanted to be a tattoo artist. Now you are one.

I splash water on my face and get ready to start the tattoo.

"REEEE!"

"We haven't started yet, that's just a pen." - the idiot couldn't wait 5 minutes and had already started touching it and rubbing away the ink and I had to redo a couple of lines.

"Ohh, heehee! It's going to look so good I'm so excited."

Even if you manage to live long enough for anyone to see this, they'll somehow think you look even worse than you already do, you fat fuck.

So I start and it's moving around like someone shoved a cattle prod in its legs. It doesn't shut the fuck up for one second, even when I take the needle off.

"Please stay still, I can't work like this."

"What do you mean? I'm hardly moving."

Guys when you move during tattoos (I'm sorry if there are other artists, or those with a lot of tattoos, don't mean to patronise), a line that should look like this: _______ looks like this ........ On this sack of cream cheese it's even fucking harder. I'm trying to stretch the skin and there's so much fluid retention, and its blood is so unhealthy, but I just focus on that one spot and keep working. 20 minutes go by. Clear calligraphy and could use a touch up but I just can't do it anymore.

"Is it done??"

"Yes", I sigh; throwing my gloves the bin and standing back up.

"Can I come back next week? I also want a piece on my butt-"

"No I won't be here next week."

"Ohh I just thought-"

"Yep, today's my last day. That'll be 80 today."

It slaps a meaty hock in my hand, filled with 20 notes, which seem to have duck fat smeared on them.

"Uh, thanks."

"At least your last tattoo here was a cheeky one!", it oinked, attempting to wink at me, but instead looking like a pig having a stroke.

"Get out."

It waddled away confused, as if it had no idea that trauma it caused me being so close to its moose knuckle. So there you have it. I never had to do anything quite as gross as that before, and when asked, I can now refuse.

In retrospect I can look back and laugh at this, my friend certainly does even though it was fucking gross. I'm glad I never have to do something like that again.
